title: Untangle the three effects in DescriptionEditor
prompt: DescriptionEditor has three effects and three bugs: a stale derived count, a prop→state sync that clobbers typing, and a resize listener with no cleanup. Derive, delete, and fix the subscription.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can type: the input keeps what was typed instead of reverting to the prop
The character count matches the current text on every keystroke
Two resize events increment the resize counter by exactly two (one listener, cleaned up on unmount)
The initial value still comes from the description prop
